logistics_program: a quay wall with bollards and fenders
a rail apron running the length of the quay under a gantry crane
a heated transit warehouse behind the apron
a port office with sight of the quay
a fuel and water point for vessels
circulation: quay to apron to warehouse to rail is a continuous handling route
damage_constraints: the gantry is derailed at one end of its travel; the quay and warehouse stand
derive all damage and occupation only from the immutable clean master
use an authored fracture with a gravity-consistent rubble apron, never a cleared box and never per-block random deletion

required_manual_checks: the handling sequence is followable from the water inland
